description: Three clock dividers, each sending a pulse once it has counted a set number of clock ticks

params.text: Sets that counter's running total back to zero
Sets how many clock ticks that counter takes before it pulses, 1 to 64

inputs.text: A trigger here sets that counter's running total back to zero

outputs.text: A 1ms 10V pulse each time that counter reaches its set number, after which it starts again

notes: A counter counts the pulses arriving at its CLK IN jack, so with nothing patched there its output never pulses.
